text_block_list.text:
That was a pretty decent result.
As expected of Sei-chan—she can do anything if she tries.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Man, that was so close, though.
Just a tiny bit more."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Guess my plan was a little half-baked, huh...

How should I surprise everyone next~?
I gotta come up with an even more amazing scheme.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: It'd be great if it's something that completely tricks even Trainer, right~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Looking at the confident Seiun Sky gave me the distinct feeling that she really might take 1st place next time.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Geez, Trainer,
look at you getting all fired up~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: If you're going that far, I suppose I wouldn't mind cooking up a little scheme for you~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Because I haven't startled them nearly enough yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seiun Sky murmured softly
and quietly to herself.
